question: Explain the idea or language feature presented in 104.4 “Let us learn” using evidence from the text.
answer: I Read the following words from the text.
marking_points: I Read the following words from the text.
Compound words are formed by combining two words of different parts of speech to create a new word that has an entirely new meaning.
They are of three types─hyphenated (Cat’s-food-Man), open compound words (bird language) and closed compound words (flowerpots).
